\begin{document}
For $0 < x < 1$ we use the elementary results
\begin{equation}
\frac{d\,\tan^{-1} x}{dx} = \frac{1}{1+x^2}
\label{eq:a1}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\tanh^{-1} x = \frac{1}{2}\ln\frac{1+x}{1-x}
\label{eq:a2}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\sin\left(\sin^{-1} x\right) = x
\label{eq:a3}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\cos\left(\sin^{-1} x\right) = \sqrt{1-x^2}
\label{eq:a4}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
